caf80eb996ce00.x: Kumik, known for its Tibetan Buddhist heritage, preserves Kanjur manuscripts, which are canonical Buddhist scriptures.

ca3d3af299af38.s: The Musi river, a tributary of the Krishna, originates in the:
ca3d3af299af38.x: The Musi originates in the Ananthagiri Hills, not the Nilgiri Hills, and is a tributary of the Krishna.

cad4e40d795c32.s: The International Day of Rural Women was first observed in:
cad4e40d795c32.x: It was first observed in 2008 after Resolution 62/136 of 2007; UN Women was set up in 2010 and CEDAW adopted in 1979.

ca3a382b323f24.s: The International Day of Charity, observed by the UN since 2012, falls on:
ca3a382b323f24.x: The International Day of Charity is on 5 September, the same day as Teachers' Day in India.

cab04c0f1c8b37.s: Which State became the first to offer free registration of rural residential properties?
cab04c0f1c8b37.x: Madhya Pradesh became the first State with free registration of rural residential properties, launched during the Seva Sankalp Abhiyan.

ca44e7c332218c.s: The International Film Festival of India (IFFI) was first held in:
ca44e7c332218c.x: IFFI was first held in 1952; the National Film Awards date to 1954.

ca436aff47f7b3.s: The Scinde Dawk, India's first adhesive postage stamp, was issued in:
ca436aff47f7b3.x: Scinde Dawk was issued in 1852; stamps were issued nationwide in 1854.

ca03513d1d4844.s: World Space Week, whose 2026 theme is “Rocket Revolution”, is observed from:
ca03513d1d4844.x: World Space Week is observed from 4 to 10 October; it was declared by the UN General Assembly in 1999.

ca52aeea468aec.s: Which port became the site of India's first port-based e-Methanol plant?
ca52aeea468aec.x: Deendayal Port hosts the first port-based e-Methanol plant; Dhamra became the first major private multi-cargo port fully on renewable power.

ca652bc6e7556c.s: The International Day of the Girl Child, declared by UNGA Resolution 66/170, was first observed on:
ca652bc6e7556c.x: It was declared in 2011 by Resolution 66/170 and first observed on 11 October 2012.

ca725e4e8d4fc9.s: Hindi Diwas on 14 September marks the adoption of Hindi in Devanagari in the year:
ca725e4e8d4fc9.x: Hindi Diwas marks the 1949 adoption of Hindi in Devanagari; it has been observed since 1953.

cab2b37ac557f8.s: In which year was the SVAMITVA scheme, which uses drones to map rural properties, introduced by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj?
cab2b37ac557f8.x: SVAMITVA was introduced in 2020 by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj.

ca3b315ffb5cac.s: The BRICS Theatre Festival 2026, themed “Shared Stories, Shared Futures”, featured 10 groups presenting how many plays?
ca3b315ffb5cac.x: The festival featured 10 groups and 11 plays as part of India's BRICS Chairship 2026.

ca85a71ef2f191.s: The Bagh Cave Paintings, added to UNESCO's Tentative List, comprise how many Buddhist rock-cut caves?
ca85a71ef2f191.x: Bagh Cave Paintings comprise 9 Buddhist rock-cut caves; Udaigiri has 20 caves.

cad26b648b043d.s: The World Circular Economy Forum began during the centenary of which country's independence?
cad26b648b043d.x: The World Circular Economy Forum began during the centenary of Finland's independence.

caed945239023e.s: The World Congress of Gastroenterology 2026, hosted in India for the first time, is being held in:
caed945239023e.x: WCOG 2026 is scheduled in New Delhi from 1 to 3 October 2026.

caea18538191f6.s: World Digestive Health Day is observed on:
caea18538191f6.x: World Digestive Health Day is observed on 29 May, not 29 April.

ca6d15e7dd3efd.s: Which of the following Andhra Pradesh–Australia MoU pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Inclusive education – Teacher capacity for children with autism and neurodiverse needs
Student mental health – Free pilot with virtual counselling and wellness tools
Skill development – Centre of Excellence for Solar Manufacturing at IIT Tirupati
Clean energy – Centre of Excellence for Solar Manufacturing at IIT Tirupati
ca6d15e7dd3efd.x: The Solar Manufacturing Centre at IIT Tirupati is the clean energy MoU; skill development covers vocational education, global certifications and international jobs.

ca99b885a47171.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Orvakal Drone City?
o: India needs more than 6 lakh drones against about 40,000 available
It is expected to create about 5,000 direct and 25,000 indirect jobs
In Phase 1, 12 plots were identified and 8 allotted
A special committee was asked to act on industry demands within 6 months
ca99b885a47171.x: The special committee was to act on industry demands within 3 months, not 6.

ca3b194be9cc16.s: Which of the following is NOT among the energy-sector adaptation measures suggested under the AP State Action Plan on Climate Change 2025–30?
o: Efficient drinking-water pumping and lift irrigation
ca3b194be9cc16.x: The pumping target concerns efficient drinking-water pumping and lift irrigation, not agricultural canal pumping.

nfbd4afe36c6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport?
o: It replaced the civil enclave at INS Dega
It was developed by the Airports Authority of India
It was described as the first greenfield airport since 2014
nfbd4afe36c6.x: The airport was developed by GMR through GVIAL, not by the Airports Authority of India.

cad9c9d0d2b590.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: facts carry no dates)
cad9c9d0d2b590.s: A rail line to the port at the revived Kakinada SEZ is proposed from which station?
cad9c9d0d2b590.x: A rail line is proposed from Annavaram station to the port; the Bharatmala NH also passes through the KSEZ.

ca855510a0e380.s: At Bharat Tex 2026, a sustainable textile recycling facility worth up to ₹4,000 crore was proposed at:
ca855510a0e380.x: The ₹4,000-crore recycling facility is proposed at Visakhapatnam, part of two AP MoUs worth up to ₹4,100 crore.

cae1be3199964d.s: The first Google AI Lab in Andhra Pradesh was established at:
cae1be3199964d.x: The lab is at Vignan's University, Vadlamudi (Guntur district), set up with Gemini Enterprise for Education.

caa727baf815ad.s: The AP State Action Plan on Climate Change 2025–30 targets raising renewable energy's share of the energy mix to:
caa727baf815ad.x: The plan targets a 40% renewable share, along with one lakh EV charging stations, aligned with SDG 7.

ca057b1faab231.s: The Chintalapudi and Recharla coal blocks, proposed for Underground Coal Gasification in Eluru district, lie in the:
ca057b1faab231.x: The blocks hold about 3,130.61 MT of coal deeper than 600 m in the Godavari Valley; UCG converts coal in situ into syngas of H₂ and CO.

ca72c946658e25.s: What share did Andhra Pradesh receive in the regional action plan on human–elephant conflict?
ca72c946658e25.x: Andhra Pradesh received 17% while Kerala received 20%; the report was released in Visakhapatnam on World Elephant Day.

ca9238272a27ae.s: The Catch the Rain campaign in Nandyal covered planning in all ____ Gram Panchayats, with works approved by the Gram Sabha.
ca9238272a27ae.x: Planning covered all 489 Gram Panchayats under the principle “Catch the Rain, Where it Falls, When it Falls”.

caba63709cf8f1.s: Which ports are associated with the AP–UAE Food Cluster cooperation?
caba63709cf8f1.x: The cooperation is linked to Krishnapatnam and Kakinada ports, with focus produce including mangoes, bananas and cocoa.

ca06ad62cc4b73.s: The first investment under the AP–UAE Food Cluster, a ₹100-crore unit by Floor Masters International, is at:
ca06ad62cc4b73.x: The ₹100-crore unit is at Gangadhara Nellore, Chittoor district, as an export base for about 25 countries.

cabdab938a6b3d.s: Which university is responsible for training and expertise at the Centre of Excellence for Solar Manufacturing at IIT Tirupati?
cabdab938a6b3d.x: UNSW Sydney handles training and expertise in solar cell manufacturing and reliability engineering; the Centre covers solar PV manufacturing and panel recycling.

ca82ba985e7f19.s: Which heliport received India's first private Point-in-Space (PinS) Instrument Approach Procedure approval?
ca82ba985e7f19.x: Undavalli Heliport received the approval; the procedure was developed by AAI to ICAO standards.

cacc577d7c0740.s: Which became India's first major private-sector gold mine to start commercial production since Independence?
cacc577d7c0740.x: Swarnagiri became the first major private-sector gold mine in India to start commercial production since Independence.

caf561a548b87b.s: Google's America-India Connect provides a direct fibre path between Visakhapatnam and:
caf561a548b87b.x: America-India Connect links Vizag and Chennai on the east coast, supporting the subsea cable landing of the Google Cloud India AI Hub at Visakhapatnam.

cae702e97a86a1.s: Water for the Kosala Nagaram Industrial Park is to come, via a balancing reservoir, from:
cae702e97a86a1.x: Supply is planned from Galeru Nagari Sujala Sravanthi through a balancing reservoir, scheduled by December 2028.

cab141c6d44999.s: Rayalaseema's stated investment drivers include land, the State Investment Promotion Board and “ease to speed of doing ____”.
cab141c6d44999.x: The stated driver is “ease to speed of doing business”, not “doing trade”.

ca5d20798427a4.s: After Gate No. 19 was washed out in the 2024 monsoon, how many crest gates of the Tungabhadra dam were replaced?
ca5d20798427a4.x: All 33 crest gates, nearly 70 years old, were replaced after the 2024 washout of Gate No. 19.

cac3f697ae7c40.s: After being notified as an Immigration Check Post, Bhogapuram became which airport in the Category-1 list?
cac3f697ae7c40.x: Bhogapuram became the 39th airport in the Category-1 list, notified under the Immigration and Foreigners Act.

caa0fccb722ce0.s: How many people died in the Visakhapatnam Steel Plant fire accident caused by molten metal falling from a ladle?
caa0fccb722ce0.x: The toll was 8 dead; preliminary findings blamed buckets of hot molten metal falling from a ladle.

caef910c56b6f9.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Andhra Pradesh's pulse production in 2025–26?
o: AP ranked first in pulse production growth at 57.73%
Uttar Pradesh ranked second with 17.7% growth
Production rose from 9.96 lakh tonnes to 15.71 lakh tonnes
Green gram accounted for the smallest share of production
caef910c56b6f9.x: Green gram had the largest share of AP's pulse production, not the smallest.

ca2196b5f2854c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the framework of the EESL sustainability programme for AP MSMEs?
o: It is implemented under RAMP and the AP MSME & Entrepreneur Development Policy 4.0
RAMP stands for Raising and Accelerating MSME Performance
RAMP is supported by the Asian Development Bank
ca2196b5f2854c.x: RAMP is a World Bank-supported Central Sector Scheme launched in 2022 by the Ministry of MSME, not an ADB-supported one.

ca5d889c00b838.s: Under the 16th Finance Commission grants to Andhra Pradesh local bodies, Gram Panchayats receive what share?
ca5d889c00b838.x: Gram Panchayats receive 70% and Zilla Parishads 15%, subject to elections, e-Gram Swaraj records and a constituted State Finance Commission.

ca422db080c3c4.s: What GSDP growth did Andhra Pradesh record during 2024–26?
ca422db080c3c4.x: Andhra Pradesh recorded 11.3% growth during 2024–26 against Telangana's 10.7%; AP's 2019–24 growth was 10.3%.

ca9dc0ffadce3a.s: In which year was HUDCO established?
ca9dc0ffadce3a.x: HUDCO was established in 1970 and is associated with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.

caada429c2ee19.s: What was Andhra Pradesh's per capita income for 2025–26?
caada429c2ee19.x: AP's per capita income for 2025–26 was ₹2,94,507; the AP–Telangana gap widened from ₹55,817 (2018–19) to ₹1,06,854 (2023–24).

caa95afaab8c4b.s: AP's pulse production growth was attributed to a self-sufficiency drive, quality seeds, pest management, value addition and:
caa95afaab8c4b.x: Higher MSP, not lower MSP, was among the five factors cited for the growth.

ca489e02250a64.s: Which State/UT ranked first in the Performance Grading Index 2.0 for 2025–26 with a score of 766?
ca489e02250a64.x: Chandigarh ranked first with 766; Andhra Pradesh lagged in learning outcomes in mathematics and languages.

ca9e87a982c3a6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about urban local body elections in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Andhra Pradesh has 123 urban local bodies
100 urban local bodies went to the polls in 2021
23 urban local bodies were held up by court cases
12 urban local body tenures are due to end in December 2026
ca9e87a982c3a6.x: The 12 tenures are due to end in November 2026, not December 2026.

ca80f4efb1273f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about NiVU AI's tourism rollout in Andhra Pradesh?
o: It will cover 30 destinations in the first year
It will cover more than 100 destinations within two years
It offers QR-code access without an app and support in 130+ languages
It is linked to Swarna Andhra Vision-2047
ca80f4efb1273f.x: NiVU AI is to cover more than 100 destinations within three years, not two.

ca2dab44854a7d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about fishermen welfare measures in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Fishermen become eligible for pension from 50 years of age
A modern fish market is planned at Singarayakonda
Fisheries development boards are at Vijayawada and Bhimavaram
ca2dab44854a7d.x: The fisheries development boards are at Visakhapatnam and Bhimavaram, not Vijayawada and Bhimavaram.

ca9493138abc1b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Shakti programme and the JJM 2.0 plan?
o: Shakti aims to strengthen Gram Sabhas under the PESA Act, 1996
Committees under Shakti are to have 50% women
The JJM 2.0 action plan concerns rural drinking-water maintenance
The first annual plan under JJM 2.0 is to be prepared within 60 days
ca9493138abc1b.x: The first annual plan under the JJM 2.0 action plan is to be prepared within 90 days, not 60 days.

ca4c7ab825a956.s: With reference to the waste-to-energy plants under Swachh Andhra–Swarna Andhra, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
ca4c7ab825a956.x: The two plants at Kadapa and Kurnool have a combined 15 MW; the cost is ₹330 crore and the State plans 8 such plants.

ca5dedceebfd8f.shape: one-liner (match not possible: too few paired facts)
ca5dedceebfd8f.s: Mee Mart in Andhra Pradesh is a partnership between the AP Civil Supplies Department and:
ca5dedceebfd8f.x: Mee Mart is a partnership with the National Cooperative Consumers Federation of India (NCCF); Digital Rupee integration is planned for subsidies.

cab26ec1a24702.s: With reference to Prashast 2.0 disability screening in AP schools, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Part-II – Bhavita Centre staff, by September 2026
cab26ec1a24702.x: Part-I is done by class teachers by September 2026; Part-II by special educators and Bhavita Centre staff by October 2026.

ca34a4e67d6991.s: With reference to Talliki Vandanam eligibility, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Rural income limit – below ₹12,000 per month
Electricity consumption – below 300 units per month
ca34a4e67d6991.x: The electricity criterion is below 300 units per month; the rural income limit is below ₹10,000, wet land up to 3 acres and dry land up to 10 acres.

cacc9b6ec9faae.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: facts carry no dates)
cacc9b6ec9faae.s: Under Nethannala Sevalo, loom-owning handloom families in Andhra Pradesh receive per year:
cacc9b6ec9faae.x: Nethannala Sevalo provides ₹25,000 a year to loom-owning families; free power is given up to 200 units per month.

ca44a27c61713a.s: The AP Common Zoning Regulations, 2026 reduced land-use categories from 16 to:
ca44a27c61713a.x: The land-use categories were reduced from 16 to 9; the regulations exclude the Capital City Area.

ca6d534f1682cf.s: What annual growth rate does the Swarna Andhra @2047 Vision target?
ca6d534f1682cf.x: The vision targets 15% annual growth; the CAGR achieved during 2014–2019 was 13.5%.

n0c13cfe6b79.s: Andhra Pradesh's Annadata Sukhibhava provides how much assistance per farmer?
n0c13cfe6b79.x: Annadata Sukhibhava gives ₹20,000 per farmer, while Telangana's Rythu Bharosa gives ₹12,000 per acre.

cada09a70d0aba.s: The Food Planet Prize was founded by which Swedish foundation?
cada09a70d0aba.x: The Food Planet Prize was founded by Sweden's Curt Bergfors Foundation, which promotes sustainable food systems.

n9ee4962ba64.s: Andhra Pradesh Community Managed Natural Farming (APCNF) is implemented by:
n9ee4962ba64.x: APCNF is implemented by Rythu Sadhikara Samstha; it won the Food Planet Prize 2026 awarded in Sweden.

ca6c7bced4b06d.s: Under AP's Treated Wastewater Reuse Policy 2026, industries must use 40% treated water by:
ca6c7bced4b06d.x: Industries are to use 20% treated water by 2028 and 40% by 2030; all 123 ULBs are to be covered by 2030.

n3ec80d85da3.s: How much does Thalliki Vandanam provide per child per year, credited to the mother?
n3ec80d85da3.x: Thalliki Vandanam provides ₹15,000 per child per year to the mother, for Classes 1 to 12 from 2025–26.

caded96470c689.s: The first Mee Mart outlet was opened at:
caded96470c689.x: The first Mee Mart outlet was opened at Lalupuram near Guntur; the target is 1,000 outlets, with 553 ready in the first phase.

cad34e9facd04a.s: The Zero Poverty P4 principle under Swarna Andhra @2047 envisages the top 10% supporting the bottom:
cad34e9facd04a.x: Zero Poverty P4 envisages the top 10% supporting the bottom 20% through philanthropy and mentorship.

ca7414c44990fb.s: Under Talliki Vandanam, how much of the ₹15,000 annual assistance is deducted for school maintenance, sanitation and hygiene?
ca7414c44990fb.x: ₹2,000 is deducted from the ₹15,000 for school maintenance, sanitation and hygiene.

ca7caa975a3a04.s: The national e-Sanjeevani telemedicine programme was launched in:
ca7caa975a3a04.x: e-Sanjeevani dates to 2019 and is run by the Health Ministry; AP is expanding Sanjeevani statewide as an “AI doctor”.

ca48ff52368009.s: What allocation has the Suryalanka–Chirala tourism corridor received under Swadesh Darshan?
ca48ff52368009.x: The corridor has an allocation of ₹97 crore under Swadesh Darshan.

ca2604fc4c3bc0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Andhra Sahitya Parishad Government Museum and Research Institute, Kakinada?
o: It holds about 5,000 palm-leaf manuscripts from the 17th–19th centuries
About 5,000 manuscripts were chemically treated in 2021
The Andhra Sahitya Parishad handed over the collection in the 1970s
It also holds Buddhist pillars, megalithic tools and coins
ca2604fc4c3bc0.x: 500 manuscripts, not 5,000, were chemically treated in 2021.

ca1d3e7cc241d7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Reddy Kingdom and its inscriptions?
o: Prolaya Vema Reddy founded the Reddy Kingdom
Kondaveedu was the first capital of the Reddy Kingdom
The Rudrapadam inscription records two Shiva temples built under Anavema Reddy
The inscription was found at Kondaveedu, Palnadu district
ca1d3e7cc241d7.x: Addanki, not Kondaveedu, was the first capital of the Reddy Kingdom; Kondaveedu is where the inscription was found.

caf4dc5f9679a7.s:
Arrange the forms of Guntur's name in the order of their evolution:
1. Gunturu
2. Kunturu
3. Gomturu
caf4dc5f9679a7.x: The name evolved Kunturu → Gomturu → Gunturu; the 10th-century Ederu copper plates use Gomturu.

ca0c1301590f7b.s: What is the Centre–State funding pattern for the new building of the Andhra Sahitya Parishad Museum, Kakinada?
ca0c1301590f7b.x: The pattern is 80:20 for total support of ₹10 crore; the building is ground-plus-four.

ca214bf0da0f64.s: What is the IUCN status of the Indian Pangolin?
ca214bf0da0f64.x: The Indian Pangolin is Endangered, while the Chinese Pangolin is Critically Endangered.

ca50b46fabfc4f.s: Gummadi Gopalakrishna received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2024 in which field?
ca50b46fabfc4f.x: Gummadi Gopalakrishna was honoured for Theatre; Suryanarayana Kumar for Kuchipudi and Durmetti Ramaiah for Telangana folk dance.

cad98abcd1d3f2.s: The Sangeet Natak Akademi, which honoured eleven artists from AP and Telangana, was established in:
cad98abcd1d3f2.x: The Sangeet Natak Akademi was established in 1952 in New Delhi under the Ministry of Culture.

ca5a4d0e197a0c.s: The earliest reference to Guntur is found in which record?
ca5a4d0e197a0c.x: The Pune copper plates of Eastern Chalukya king Vishnuvardhana II, of his first regnal year 669 CE, give the earliest reference.

ca068a9319a901.s: Andhra Pradesh holds what share of India's baryte reserves?
ca068a9319a901.x: Andhra Pradesh holds 92% of India's baryte reserves; Mangampeta is among the world's largest deposits.

cad492dbf33928.s: Sovereignty over a World Heritage Site rests with:
cad492dbf33928.x: A World Heritage Site stays under the sovereignty of the country concerned; the status does not transfer it to UNESCO.

ca426875dcf107.s: The prices of wood supplied through Craft Wood Banks are set by a committee led by the:
ca426875dcf107.x: A committee led by the PCCF sets the prices; the National Mission on Handicrafts is under the Ministry of Textiles.

ca6199dfdde8e5.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: D.C. Wadhwa v. State of Bihar (1986) – Repeated re-promulgation of Ordinances is unconstitutional
Krishna Kumar Singh v. State of Bihar (2017) – 99th Amendment and NJAC Act struck down
Article 13(3)(a) – “Law” includes custom or usage having the force of law
SC Advocates-on-Record Association (2015) – 99th Amendment and NJAC Act struck down
ca6199dfdde8e5.x: Krishna Kumar Singh held that an Ordinance is not a substitute for legislation; the NJAC was struck down in the Advocates-on-Record Association case.

ca004d80e92402.s: Which of the following pairs on advocates' duty to represent is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Kuldeep Agarwal v. State of Uttarakhand (2019) – Refusal in special circumstances is for an individual advocate, not the Bar
Madras High Court (2025) – Obstruction of lawyers for Kashmiri students may be contempt
BCI Rules – An advocate is generally bound to accept a brief
Karnataka High Court (2020) – Obstruction of lawyers for Kashmiri students may be contempt
ca004d80e92402.x: The Madras High Court (2025) held that a Bar is not a trade union; the contempt observation came from the Karnataka High Court (2020).

ca6ac80d73f248.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about rulings on Bar Associations and representation of accused persons?
o: A.S. Mohammed Rafi v. State of Tamil Nadu was decided by the Supreme Court in 2010
A.S. Mohammed Rafi held boycott resolutions wholly illegal, null and void
Kuldeep Agarwal (2019) held that refusal in special circumstances is a matter for the Bar Association
ca6ac80d73f248.x: Kuldeep Agarwal held that refusal in special circumstances is for an individual advocate, not the Bar.

caa905260fa838.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Indian privacy and right-to-be-forgotten cases?
o: K.S. Puttaswamy recognised privacy as a fundamental right
The Orissa High Court (2020) held the right to be forgotten automatic in ongoing proceedings
In Dharamraj Bhanushankar Dave, the Gujarat High Court denied removal of acquittal details
caa905260fa838.x: The Orissa High Court (2020) only called for debate on the right to be forgotten in the context of online sexual abuse; it did not hold the right automatic.

ca4f404dfd44b0.s: Which of the following State – Zonal Council pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
ca4f404dfd44b0.x: Madhya Pradesh is in the Central Zonal Council (with Chhattisgarh, Uttarakhand and Uttar Pradesh); the Western Zonal Council has Goa, Gujarat, Maharashtra and DNH & DD.

cac3060e788389.s: CoBRA, the CRPF unit used against Left-Wing Extremism, stands for:
cac3060e788389.x: CoBRA is the Commando Battalion for Resolute Action under the CRPF.

cad3e9b01f7c3c.s: On 24 January 1950, who accorded Vande Mataram equal honour with Jana Gana Mana?
cad3e9b01f7c3c.x: Rajendra Prasad accorded Vande Mataram equal honour with Jana Gana Mana on 24 January 1950.

cab60d44763146.s: Which amendment to the FCRA banned sub-granting of foreign contribution?
cab60d44763146.x: The 2020 amendment banned sub-granting; the 2022 amendment raised the limit for relatives' contributions.

ca736a8dca810f.s: A person's name on the electoral roll gives what kind of presumption of citizenship?
ca736a8dca810f.x: A name on the roll gives only an evidentiary presumption; the ECI may examine citizenship prima facie but cannot finally declare a non-citizen.

ca5b3b35bac831.s: The designated-authority framework in the FCRA Amendment Bill, 2026 replaces the framework under which Section?
ca5b3b35bac831.x: The Bill replaces the Section 15 framework, letting a Centre-appointed authority manage foreign-funded assets when registration ends.

ca55a1c1fe7d49.s: Under the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Rules, 2026, registration is tied to a Schedule of how many permissible purposes?
ca55a1c1fe7d49.x: Registration is tied to a Schedule of 105 permissible purposes; proselytisation is excluded from permitted religious activities.

ca1a80b72e3eaa.s: In Bijoe Emmanuel v. State of Kerala, the silence of Jehovah's Witness students was protected under:
ca1a80b72e3eaa.x: The silence was protected under Articles 19(1)(a) and 25; the ruling did not require the students to sing.

ca0c5c15fe1389.s: Trial in absentia under Section 356 of the BNSS applies to a proclaimed offender for offences punishable with imprisonment of:
ca0c5c15fe1389.x: It applies to offences punishable with ten years or more, life imprisonment or death; trial may begin 90 days after charges are framed.

ca41326f7215fb.s: Which Supreme Court case held that the creamy layer principle does not apply to SCs and STs?
ca41326f7215fb.x: Ashoka Kumar Thakur (2008) held the creamy layer does not apply to SCs and STs; Indra Sawhney upheld it for OBCs.

caa4b5e05096f0.s: For how many years is FCRA registration valid?
caa4b5e05096f0.x: FCRA registration is valid for 5 years; annual returns are filed in Form FC-4 and administrative expenses are capped at 20%.

ca912901d95266.s: The 2026 Presidential Ordinance under Article 123 raised the sanctioned strength of the Supreme Court from 34 to:
ca912901d95266.x: The Ordinance raised the strength from 34 to 38 judges; five judges were then sworn in.

ca7270ec7afcd0.s: In 1950, the strength of the Supreme Court, including the Chief Justice of India, was:
ca7270ec7afcd0.x: The Supreme Court had 8 judges including the CJI in 1950, raised to 11 in 1956.

ca95d4c210200c.s: The Industrial Relations Code, 2020 merged the Trade Unions Act, 1926, the Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 1946 and the:
ca95d4c210200c.x: The Code merged the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 with the two other Acts; the Supreme Court held the 1947 definition of ‘industry’ cannot apply unchanged.

cacb1c907a8b71.s: Where was the 31st Southern Zonal Council meeting held on 20 August 2026?
cacb1c907a8b71.x: The meeting was held at Mahabalipuram, Tamil Nadu, chaired by Union Home Minister Amit Shah.

cab20c8c7632c7.s: The Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Act, 2026 amends which Section of the 1971 Act?
cab20c8c7632c7.x: The Act amends Section 3, giving Vande Mataram the same protection as the National Anthem against disturbance of singing.

ca20bcf887a266.s: The India Justice Report 2025 placed the number of judges in India at about how many per million population?
ca20bcf887a266.x: The India Justice Report 2025 put it at about 15.9 judges per million; 50 per million is the Law Commission's recommendation.

ca69b8c5f966f6.s: Under the e-Courts initiative, the JustIS App is meant for:
ca69b8c5f966f6.x: The JustIS App is for judges, while the e-Courts Services App is for litigants.

ca7adfa902c84d.s: Fast Track Courts were first introduced in India in:
ca7adfa902c84d.x: Fast Track Courts were first introduced in 2000; the Public Examinations Act, 2024 covers UPSC, SSC, RRB, NTA and IBPS exams.

cad1059481662f.s: In February 2026, women made up what share of High Court judges in India (116 of 781)?
cad1059481662f.x: Women were 116 of 781 High Court judges, or 14.85%, in February 2026.

nac480c8c9ba.s: The Kerala (Alteration of Name) Act, 2026 changes the name of Kerala to:
nac480c8c9ba.x: The Act renames Kerala as Keralam; it passed the Lok Sabha on 11 August and the Rajya Sabha on 12 August 2026.

ca2f4290cd3874.s: The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026 amends the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Act of:
ca2f4290cd3874.x: It amends the 1956 Act and raises the strength to 38, the first increase since 2019.

ndafc39e260f.s: The e-Courts Mission Mode Project is run by the Supreme Court e-Committee with:
ndafc39e260f.x: The e-Courts Mission Mode Project is run by the SC e-Committee with NIC and has 30 virtual courts for petty offences.

nda1a130c632.s: Under the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment, 2026, the probe must be completed within:
nda1a130c632.x: The probe must be completed within 60 days; the amendment provides 5–10 years' jail, a fine up to ₹50 lakh and special fast-track courts.

ca2fd583eca186.s: Under the CrPC, proclamation against an absconder was provided in Section:
ca2fd583eca186.x: CrPC Section 82 dealt with proclamation against an absconder; Section 299 with evidence in his absence and Section 317 with dispensing with personal attendance.

nd23a7e92722.s: The Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Bill, 2026, which replaced a May 2026 ordinance, was passed as a:
nd23a7e92722.x: It was passed as a Money Bill; the Rajya Sabha only returned it and did not reject it.

ca6bf79ee960a0.s: Under Section 187(3) of the BNSS, detention in cases punishable with death, life or 10+ years may extend to how many days before default bail?
ca6bf79ee960a0.x: Detention may extend to 90 days in such cases and 60 days in others, after which default bail follows.

ca6af1b41a3401.s: In which case did the Delhi High Court issue guidelines on the Right to be Forgotten?
o: K.S. Puttaswamy v. Union of India
Dharamraj Bhanushankar Dave v. State of Gujarat
Shreya Singhal v. Union of India
Laksh Vir Singh Yadav v. Union of India
ca6af1b41a3401.x: The Delhi High Court guidelines came in Laksh Vir Singh Yadav v. Union of India; Puttaswamy (2017) established privacy as a Fundamental Right.

ca7ac739d48206.s: Under which Article can Parliament alter the name, area or boundaries of a State?
ca7ac739d48206.x: Article 3 empowers Parliament to alter a State's name, area or boundaries; the State's opinion is not binding.

ca0569642a59c4.s: Which Article provides for equal justice and free legal aid as a Directive Principle of State Policy?
ca0569642a59c4.x: Article 39A provides for equal justice and free legal aid.

ca0bd20a90e0a7.s: Where was the judicial cooperation MoU between the Supreme Courts of India and Russia signed?
ca0bd20a90e0a7.x: The MoU was signed in Moscow by CJI Surya Kant and Russian Chief Justice Igor Krasnov.

caeb9c4e5ae8f7.s: Trial in absentia, which the NIA may seek, is provided under which Section of the BNSS, 2023?
caeb9c4e5ae8f7.x: Section 356 of the BNSS provides for trial in absentia; it is not meant for minor offences.

cab5192109bdee.s: The creamy layer principle in reservations currently applies to:
cab5192109bdee.x: The creamy layer currently applies to OBCs; the Centre opposed petitions seeking to extend it to SC/ST reservations.

ca3448891c0b7d.s: In which year did the Naxalbari uprising begin in West Bengal?
ca3448891c0b7d.x: The Naxalbari uprising began in 1967; the 2015 National Policy and Action Plan on LWE rests on Dialogue, Security and Coordination.

ca953bd2c6adaf.s: Under the draft Andaman and Nicobar Islands Tribal Councils Election Rules, 2026, the Chief Captain of each Island Tribal Council is to be chosen by:
ca953bd2c6adaf.x: The draft proposes a direct vote for the Chief Captain; Nicobarese leaders fear this may weaken consensus-based customary self-governance.

ca583e83fadfa0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about prison data and related legal provisions?
o: Delhi and Bihar had an undertrial share above 87%
Hussainara Khatoon v. State of Bihar was decided in 1979
Sunil Batra v. Delhi Administration affirmed that prisoners retain fundamental rights
Under Section 479 of BNSS, a first-time offender is eligible for release on bond after one-half of the maximum sentence
ca583e83fadfa0.x: Section 479 of the BNSS allows release of a first-time offender after one-third, not one-half, of the maximum sentence.

cafdc01a1a0d9c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the CAG audit of amenities at railway stations?
o: The audit was tabled on 12 August 2026
Testing was not as per norms at 59 stations in six railway zones
E. coli was found at stations including Hyderabad
The CAG is appointed by Parliament
cafdc01a1a0d9c.x: The CAG is appointed by the President, not by Parliament.

nfc248344acd.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about proposals linked to simultaneous elections?
o: The 2018 Law Commission draft proposed a constructive no-confidence motion
The constructive no-confidence motion is borrowed from the United Kingdom
The Kovind Committee proposed a phased model of simultaneous elections
The Kovind Committee proposed local-body polls within 100 days of Lok Sabha and Assembly polls
nfc248344acd.x: The constructive no-confidence motion is borrowed from Germany, not the United Kingdom.

caf55f922827f7.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: facts carry no dates)
caf55f922827f7.s: With heatwave and lightning added under the SDRF/NDRF guidelines for 2026–2031, the number of notified natural calamities rose from 12 to:
caf55f922827f7.x: Adding heatwave and lightning raised the notified calamities from 12 to 14; victims receive relief under SDRF/NDRF norms.

n70df4c57801.s: The term of the Joint Parliamentary Committee on simultaneous elections was extended to the last week of the:
n70df4c57801.x: The JPC's term was extended to the last week of the Monsoon Session of 2026; its report was still pending.

ca5096bce79abd.s: Sowa-Rigpa (Amchi), the traditional medicine system of the Himalayan region, was recognised in:
ca5096bce79abd.x: Sowa-Rigpa was recognised in 2010; Siddha is associated with Tamil Nadu.

cae7c2acc0671d.s: In 2025, an illegal sex-determination network was busted in which State?
cae7c2acc0671d.x: The network was busted in Karnataka, not Tamil Nadu; high-frequency linear probes used for breast and thyroid imaging cannot image foetal sex.

ca56148392ff60.s: The National Commission for Women was established in:
ca56148392ff60.x: The NCW was established in 1992 under the NCW Act, 1990; its initiatives include Yashoda AI and She Serves.

cadbde5cf11b01.s: Operation Chakra–6 (June 2026) against digital arrest scams was conducted by:
cadbde5cf11b01.x: Operation Chakra–6 was a CBI operation against digital arrest scams.

cac93e17e269b7.s: The three pillars of NITI Aayog's Strategic Roadmap for Making Ayurveda Global are Availability, Acceptability and:
cac93e17e269b7.x: The pillars are Availability, Acceptability and Propagation, in a phased strategy up to 2047.

ca65aabcbebd71.s: The companion legislation to the Constitution (129th Amendment) Bill, 2024 concerns which Union Territories?
o: Delhi, Puducherry and Jammu and Kashmir
Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh and Chandigarh
ca65aabcbebd71.x: The companion Union Territories Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2024 concerns Delhi, Puducherry and J&K; local bodies are excluded from the 129th Amendment Bill.

n44c8b755ba7.s: Who became chair of the National Commission for Minorities in July 2026?
n44c8b755ba7.x: Harjit Singh Grewal became NCM chair in July 2026; the NCM is a statutory body under the NCM Act, 1992.

ca7492787059e8.s: Under MHA rules, a new renewable-energy project within how many km of the International Border needs a Ministry of Defence NOC?
ca7492787059e8.x: Projects within 20 km of the International Border require a Ministry of Defence NOC.

caec05639ba861.s: Which force has been designated the Recognized Security Organization for port security audits and training?
caec05639ba861.x: CISF is the Recognized Security Organization; the proposed Bureau of Port Security will handle physical and cyber security of ports and ships.

ca7e6a0fa7a561.s: Under MHA rules, no new solar, wind or hybrid project can be set up within what distance of the LoC, LAC or IB?
ca7e6a0fa7a561.x: New projects are banned within 1 km; the 50 km zone needs prior security clearance, not an outright ban.

ca6ce2c5fdab77.s: The Civil Defence Volunteer Force announced from the Red Fort is governed by the Civil Defence Act of:
ca6ce2c5fdab77.x: The relevant law is the Civil Defence Act, 1968 with the Civil Defence Rules, 1968; MHA is the nodal ministry.

ca01ab98fe9e6c.s: The Strategic Roadmap for Making Ayurveda Global, which covers education, research, regulation, insurance, branding and medical value travel, was released by:
ca01ab98fe9e6c.x: It is NITI Aayog's roadmap, and it goes beyond exports to cover education, research, regulation, insurance, branding and medical value travel.

ca8965f489e289.s: The Line of Control (LoC) in Jammu and Kashmir separates India and:
ca8965f489e289.x: The LoC is the India–Pakistan line in J&K; the LAC denotes the India–China boundary.

ca765a8706caa8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Viksit Bharat–Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025?
o: AI and GPS are used for monitoring
Its assets focus on water security and rural infrastructure
It was initiated from Bandlapalli in Anantapur
The Ministry of Rural Development is headed by Shivraj Singh Chouhan
ca765a8706caa8.x: Bandlapalli in Anantapur was where MGNREGA was launched; the new Mission was initiated from Tirupati district.

ca16efcfee3db6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan and related institutions?
o: The Abhiyaan has reached 29.32 crore people
It is associated with the Ministry of Social Justice
The Ministry of Tribal Affairs was established in 1999
ca16efcfee3db6.x: The Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan was launched on 15 August 2020, not 2021.

ca288eda8f7905.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: Garbhini Mitra is a six-month Ayurveda-based maternal-care course
Garbhini Mitra candidates must be senior secondary pass and 18 or above
Srijan: Voices from the Loom was held on National Handloom Day
Srijan: Voices from the Loom was organised by the Ministry of AYUSH
ca288eda8f7905.x: Srijan: Voices from the Loom was a Ministry of Textiles event; the Ministry of AYUSH is linked to Garbhini Mitra.

ca1668783fb9a7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan and related bodies?
o: More than 1 crore youth took the pledge on the launch day
The pledge was taken at about 10,000 centres
More than 125 spiritual organisations joined the campaign
The National Service Scheme was established in 1970
ca1668783fb9a7.x: The National Service Scheme dates to 1969, not 1970.

cacf99d2257d2f.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: White Rabbit time technology – Developed by CERN for sub-nanosecond synchronisation
73rd Constitutional Amendment coming into force – 24 April 1993
E-Commerce Council of India – Launched in 2026 by IAMAI
cacf99d2257d2f.x: PARIVARTAN replaces old trucks and buses in NCR with BS-VI or electric vehicles; the IAMAI launch refers to the E-Commerce Council of India.

caa9ad6390d101.s: Which of the following Article – provision pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Article 28 – Minorities' right to run educational institutions
Article 30 – Minorities' right to run educational institutions
Article 41 – Right to work, education and public assistance
Article 350A – Instruction in the mother tongue at the primary stage
caa9ad6390d101.x: Article 28 deals with religious instruction in educational institutions; minorities' right to run institutions is Article 30.

n2df9fdbe81c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about MISHTI?
o: It stands for Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats and Tangible Incomes
It has been extended up to 2029
Its total outlay after additional allocation is ₹600 crore
Andhra Pradesh ranked first among the States under it
n2df9fdbe81c.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked second, not first, among States under MISHTI.

ca3eaf960e4e70.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: facts carry no datable series)
ca3eaf960e4e70.s: Of the 784 provisions in 79 Acts covered by the Jan Vishwas Act, 2026, how many were decriminalised?
ca3eaf960e4e70.x: 717 provisions were decriminalised and 67 were amended.

ca3fb0edd2147f.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: facts carry no dates)
ca3fb0edd2147f.s: The average balance per Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana account is approximately:
ca3fb0edd2147f.x: The average is about ₹5,356 per account; ₹3.17 lakh crore is the aggregate deposit figure.

ca3f3013f42a11.s: Under the Jal Jeevan Mission, Union Territories receive funding in the ratio of:
ca3f3013f42a11.x: UTs receive 100% Central funding; Himalayan and NE States get 90:10 and other States 50:50.

ca6cb2ebf300a1.s: Under the National Animal Disease Control Programme, one-time Brucellosis vaccination is given to female calves aged:
ca6cb2ebf300a1.x: Brucellosis (caused by Brucella abortus) vaccination is a one-time dose for female calves aged 4–8 months.

ca9261d2c5b087.s: Which Article deals with early childhood care and education for children below 6 years as a Directive Principle?
ca9261d2c5b087.x: Article 45 concerns early childhood care and education below 6 years; Article 21A makes education a Fundamental Right.

ca4c99ef4708b0.s: The Himalayan Climate Observatory being set up by IITM and ARIES under a 50-year MoU is located at:
ca4c99ef4708b0.x: The permanent station is at Devasthal, Uttarakhand, monitoring greenhouse gases, atmospheric chemistry, air pollutants and soil moisture.

cab9d827c59618.s: The Anaemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan provides prophylactic ____ and promotes delayed cord clamping.
cab9d827c59618.x: AMB provides prophylactic Iron-Folic Acid, not calcium, and promotes delayed cord clamping.

caf5c66fe5ea90.s: What is the family-income limit for interest subvention under the PM Vidyalaxmi Scheme?
caf5c66fe5ea90.x: PM Vidyalaxmi has an ₹8 lakh limit with 3% subvention; PM-USP CSIS has a ₹4.5 lakh limit.

ca26004019d647.s: The National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission aims to eliminate sickle cell disease by:
ca26004019d647.x: The mission targets elimination by 2047 through screening, diagnosis, genetic counselling and treatment.

cade0a0fea6f3e.s: The government share of school enrolment in India, 71% in 2005, declined to what in 2024-25?
cade0a0fea6f3e.x: The government share fell to 49.24% in 2024-25, while private schools rose from 2.88 lakh to 3.31 lakh.

ca5fcb6d93821b.s: Under the Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization, what share of funds is earmarked for women farmers?
ca5fcb6d93821b.x: 30% of funds are earmarked for women farmers; the NE and Himalayan funding ratio is 90:10.

ca0f0dfaa2289a.s: Under the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, at least what share of the aggregate fund balance must remain after a partial withdrawal?
ca0f0dfaa2289a.x: At least 25% must remain; partial withdrawals fall into three groups and education withdrawals are allowed up to 10 times.

ca9954a2b4cd4c.s: Which indicator recorded the sharpest rise in NFHS-6?
ca9954a2b4cd4c.x: Rotavirus vaccine coverage rose from 36.4% to 85.4%, the sharpest rise; TFR stayed at 2.0.

ca58f58844c11a.s: The revised Anaemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan changed its 6×6×6 framework to:
ca58f58844c11a.x: It became 7×7×7 by adding LBW babies aged 0–6 months, Eating Right, and a stronger M&E framework.

caeb571ce0ced1.s: The Minimum Support Price is recommended by:
o: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices
caeb571ce0ced1.x: MSP is recommended by CACP and administered by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.

cac137be658b98.s: What outlay did the Union Cabinet approve for continuing PM-KISAN from 2026–27 to 2030–31?
cac137be658b98.x: The approved outlay is ₹3.15 lakh crore; the scheme gives ₹6,000 a year in three DBT instalments.

ca41a3ed1fd4c1.s: How many schemes are integrated with the e-Shram portal?
ca41a3ed1fd4c1.x: Fifteen schemes, including PMJJBY, PMSBY and PM Shram Yogi Maandhan, are integrated; the portal supports portability of benefits.

nd44b231534a.s: The Jal Jeevan Mission has been extended up to:
nd44b231534a.x: JJM, launched in 2019, has been extended to December 2028 to cover all rural households.

ca228a55fc15e6.s: Compressed Biogas (CBG), similar to CNG, is upgraded to about what methane content?
ca228a55fc15e6.x: CBG is upgraded to about 98% methane, against 55–65% in raw biogas.

ca8d2ca0c94c5e.s: India's cooperative sector, with more than 8.5 lakh units, has about how many members?
ca8d2ca0c94c5e.x: Cooperatives have about 32 crore members across about 30 sectors, with about 98% rural reach.

caf6bf70e44548.s: The Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana is implemented by which department of the Ministry of Finance?
caf6bf70e44548.x: PMJDY, launched on 28 August 2014, is implemented by the Department of Financial Services.

ca0f4f4b1fbf00.s: In 2025, India added more solar capacity than every country except:
ca0f4f4b1fbf00.x: Only China added more solar than India in 2025; solar is about 30% of India's installed capacity.

ca1ad7aa10e2da.s: Under the PM Vidyalaxmi Scheme, institutions ranked among the top ____ in NIRF are eligible.
ca1ad7aa10e2da.x: The top 100 NIRF institutions, top 200 State/UT government HEIs and all Central government HEIs are eligible.

caaf002569e64b.s: On 8 June 2026, West Bengal became which State/UT to implement Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY?
caaf002569e64b.x: West Bengal became the 36th State/UT; PM-JAY gives ₹5 lakh per family per year.

n27ff277d933.s: Wages under the VB-G RAM G Act are indexed to the:
n27ff277d933.x: Wages are indexed to CPI-AL; the Act provides 125 days of work and came into force on 1 July 2026.

ca5ca61fde1dde.s: Under the PM Surakshit Matritva Abhiyaan, which sticker colour on the Mother and Child Protection Card indicates high risk?
ca5ca61fde1dde.x: A red sticker indicates high risk and a green sticker no risk; screening covers 25 high-risk factors.

ca5faa8c211335.s: India's maternal mortality ratio during 2022–24 was:
ca5faa8c211335.x: MMR fell from 556 (1990) to 130 (2014–16) and 87 (2022–24), a decline of 43 points.

ca1dbcd78a57b3.s: PM-SETU, approved on 7 July 2026 with ₹60,000 crore over five years, plans to modernise how many ITIs?

n4e78d2aed77.s: How many days of work does VB-G RAM G provide to rural households?
n4e78d2aed77.x: VB-G RAM G provides 125 days of work, with an interim base wage of ₹300/day and 60:40 Centre–State wage sharing.

nc7851aee30d.s: PM-KISAN, which gives ₹6,000 a year in three instalments, has been extended up to:
nc7851aee30d.x: PM-KISAN was extended to 2030-31; income-tax payers are excluded.

nd76f13176a8.s: Critics of VB-G RAM G point to a farm-season ‘blackout’ of how many days?
nd76f13176a8.x: Critics cite a 60-day farm-season blackout and exclusion through biometric checks; States bear 40% of wages.

cae20de4af8a25.s: The Jan Samarth Portal, a single platform for credit-linked schemes, was launched on:
cae20de4af8a25.x: Jan Samarth was launched on 6 June 2022 and has completed four years.

cacb93f0e1913c.s: AMRUT 2.0, covering all 4,800 statutory towns, was launched in:
cacb93f0e1913c.x: AMRUT 2.0 was launched in October 2021; the original AMRUT covered 500 cities.

ca01db585f7ac5.s: In the Unified AMB Abhiyaan Portal, which integrated service holds immunisation records?
ca01db585f7ac5.x: U-WIN holds immunisation records, JANANI covers pregnant women and RBSK child screening.

n6f0755d365e.s: The idea of the JAM (Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile) trinity was set out in the:
n6f0755d365e.x: The JAM trinity, the base of DBT, was set out in the Economic Survey 2014-15, not the Budget.

cafd3e7f80e843.s: Existing bioenergy initiatives include SATAT, Market Development Assistance, Biomass Aggregation Machinery and the:
cafd3e7f80e843.x: The listed initiatives are SATAT, MDA, Biomass Aggregation Machinery and the National Bioenergy Programme; the 200+ CBG plants were commissioned under these, not under GOBARdhan alone.

cacecfd431b998.s: Under the RBI's revised Kisan Credit Card norms from 1 January 2027, agricultural loans up to what limit need no margin money or collateral?
cacecfd431b998.x: The limit is ₹2 lakh; repayment periods are 12 months for short-term and 18 months for long-duration crops.

cabeadb3c5d01c.s: Under the Employees' Provident Funds Scheme, 2026, who is ultimately liable for contract workers' PF contributions?
cabeadb3c5d01c.x: The principal employer stays ultimately liable, with deposit due within 15 days of month-end; the contractor is not solely responsible.

caf36a67405046.s: The e-Shram portal, India's first Aadhaar-authenticated National Database of Unorganised Workers, was launched on:
caf36a67405046.x: e-Shram was launched on 26 August 2021 and gives each worker a 12-digit UAN.

caedd7301bc561.s: The National Water Mission regards ____ as the foundation of Integrated Water Resources Management.
caedd7301bc561.x: Water budgeting compares availability with demand to show surplus or deficit, which makes it the basis of IWRM.

caa0463e4a5982.s: MAHA was launched by the Ministry of Jal Shakti together with:
caa0463e4a5982.x: MAHA was launched by the Ministry of Jal Shakti and ANRF; ISRO's MoU with Jal Shakti separately applies satellite data to water resources.

ca8bb103d9dc82.s: Which PM-AASHA component pays farmers the gap between MSP and the sale price, without procurement?
ca8bb103d9dc82.x: PDPS pays the gap between MSP and sale price without procuring the produce.

ca101d012eaa32.s: The SDG target for maternal mortality ratio by 2030 is below:
ca101d012eaa32.x: The SDG target is an MMR below 70 by 2030.

caa18de6ebeaa9.s: The National Animal Disease Control Programme was launched in:
caa18de6ebeaa9.x: NADCP was launched in September 2019; 2024 relates to the Pandemic Fund Project.

ca10812143f530.s: World Hepatitis Day is observed on:
ca10812143f530.x: World Hepatitis Day is on 28 July; the National Viral Hepatitis Control Program (2018) covers Hepatitis A to E.

caf82754dbc870.s: The GOBARdhan scheme aims to raise Compressed Biogas output by about:
caf82754dbc870.x: The scheme aims to raise CBG output about ten times, not five.

ca8b88ccdfa876.s: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana targets rooftop solar for how many households?
ca8b88ccdfa876.x: PM Surya Ghar targets 1 crore households; PM-KUSUM separately supports solar pumps and small plants.

ca95729c36a888.s: The SUMAN Roadmap–2030, aiming to end preventable maternal and newborn deaths by 2030, was launched by:
ca95729c36a888.x: The SUMAN Roadmap–2030 was launched by J.P. Nadda.

ca32c55a81b84d.s: The Anaemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, following a lifecycle approach, was launched under the National Health Mission in:
ca32c55a81b84d.x: AMB was launched in 2018 under the National Health Mission.
